event: Darryl Anka born in Ottawa, Canada (per Wikipedia-mirror bio and Astro-Databank entry title).
Two close-range daylight UFO sightings in one week over Los Angeles of a dark triangular craft (~150 ft, then ~70 ft), witnessed with family/friends; sparks Anka's metaphysical research.
Anka works (uncredited) as a model maker on Star Trek: The Motion Picture.
Anka works (uncredited) as a prop maker on Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan.

About ten years after the sightings, Anka joins a channeling class taught by Thomas Massari; six weeks in he receives a 'telepathic hit' naming Bashar and recalling a pre-life agreement to channel him; a classmate sketches the same face.

First public sessions at the home of a psychology doctoral researcher grow from 5 to 20 to 40 attendees within three weeks, then move to rented auditoriums. Official sources date public channeling to 1983 (bashar.org) or 1984 (bashar.org/about).
Bashar sessions begin to be videotaped (per Baroni 2012).
Publication of the first compilation, The New Metaphysics.
Early session 'The Legacy' (published 1990) states the Sassani are 'the children of the Greys / Zeta Reticulum and humans'.

Bashar: Blueprint for Change — A Message from Our Future published (New Solutions Publishing; ed. Luana Ewing; 302 pp.). Contains forecasts of a world government 2011–13 and a US–Soviet–Chinese alliance later judged failed.
Anka illustrates Kim Carlsberg's Beyond My Wildest Dreams: Diary of a UFO Abductee.
August 1995 session lays out the Seven Sequential Steps of Manifestation (later published on bashar.org).
Contact Cards: An Extraterrestrial Divination System released.
Quest for Truth: 100 Insights That Could Change Your Life published (Nobul Press, Iowa City; 244 pp.; with Steve Meyers).
Anka says a recorded Bashar session predicted a terrorist attack in New York 'somewhere around the year 2001' (claim not independently verified).
Hiatus: the October 20, 2001 Los Angeles session 'RSVP' is described as 'the first channeling since 1998'.
'RSVP' session in Los Angeles marks Bashar's public return, inviting humanity to decide whether it wants ET contact; 'Reconnecting with Sirius' held in Ixtapa, Mexico the same year.
Japanese 'Bashar Paperback' series (vols. 1–8) published; Japanese sales later cited as over 300,000 books.
Sessions 'Extraterrestrial Contact Act' (proposed contact legislation), 'State of Future Union' and 'Future Milestones'; Baroni dates YouTube diffusion of Bashar clips to about 2006.
Anka appears in David Thomas's documentary Tuning In: Spirit Channelers in America alongside Lee Carroll (Kryon) and others.
'Debunking the Debunkers' session: gullibility, skepticism and cynicism framed as the same rejection of truth.
'The Span 2010-2015' session: 2012 named as the pivotal year when the 'hands-off quarantine' officially ends; the Shalinaya (Yahyel) named as the first civilization to make open contact.
Sedona weekend 'A Ship to Ship Communication' at Angel Valley Retreat Center; 'Fifteen Minutes in Hyperspace' and 'Past and Future History' sessions.
'Sacred Circuitry' session introduces 15 glyphs said to originate with the Sirians to advance ET contact readiness.
'The Gateway to 2012' session (Los Angeles) frames 2012 as a threshold for collective transformation.
Francesco Baroni (Univ. of Lausanne) presents 'Darryl Anka and Bashar: Modern Channeling between Alien Narrative and Ancient Esotericism' at the CESNUR conference, El Jadida, Morocco.
Sessions 'Bashar 2.0' (upgraded frequency), 'Nexus Point' (Earth–Essassani–Sirius triad), 'UFO Witness Declaration', 'Rising from the Ashes' and 'Message from Sirius' (11-11-2012).
'Crossing the Bridge to 2013' session (Los Angeles): choosing one's state of being for the threshold.
Zia Films releases Anka's first feature, the fictional documentary Dearly Departed (84 min; dated 2012 by IMDb bio, 2013 by another bio).
'The 33rd Parallel' (Sedona): Anka first channels Willa Hillicrissing, 'a parallel reality specialist from 700 years in our future'.

Los Angeles Business Journal profiles Zia Films: $250,000 financing, ~20 crew, Dearly Departed sold for $20 online, 'Bashar: First Contact' nearing completion; Anka (61) and Erica Jordan married 20 years.
'Dream a Little Dream' (Los Angeles) celebrates the 30th anniversary of Bashar's channeling.
Buddha at the Gas Pump interview #236: Anka recounts sightings, the class, first sessions, the EEG study and the 9/11 claim; April Rochelle identified as CEO of Bashar Communications.
'Interstellar Civilizations' / three-part 'Interstellar Enneagram' weekend: claims 17 civilizations contacted humanity 1909–2009 and Earth reaches 'full involvement' with them within 30–50 years.
A 2014 session reportedly states 'In your upcoming fall of 2016 EVERYTHING will change' (blog transcription).
Boing Boing reports Anka filed copyright takedowns against Tumblr GIF artists over Bashar clips (1984–2014 event footage), drawing online mockery.
'Sedona Vortex Array' session (Sedona, AZ) unveils 'a project to further the acceleration of ET contact'; Q&A on the Yahyel.
'Cybo' session (Las Vegas): 'the Sassani word for the number 13, the vibration of transformation', taught via an Essassani game.
Documentary First Contact premieres (June 2016); US digital release September 16, 2016; narrated by James Woods; produced by Anka, Erica Jordan and April Rochelle.
'Dear Mom and Dad' (Los Angeles): open letter from the hybrid children; first wave to arrive as teenagers; group of 333 referenced.

'The Protocols of First Contact' (Sedona) details phases and procedures of first contact and interstellar-alliance adoption; also 2016: '30 Days of Disclosure', 'Amplifying First Contact', 'The Precursors', 'The Next Phase'.
'As Above So Below' (Los Angeles) on how higher non-physical levels manifest as physical reality.
First upload on the 'Bashar Channeled by Darryl Anka' YouTube channel (by 2026: ~229K subscribers, 322 videos, ~9.7M views).
'1-Epsilon' (Los Angeles): the three AI spheres Epsilon, Eclipse and Epiphany that encircle Essassani; 'Eclipse' and 'Epiphany' sessions follow in 2017.
'Window of Discovery 2018–2020' (Los Angeles): the three years after fall 2016 named a 'highly accelerated window of opportunity for discovery'.
'The Structure of Existence' (Burbank) on 'The One' / 'All That Is'.
'The Five Hybrid Races' (Anaheim, 3h20m): names and functions of the five hybrid races; humanity becoming the sixth.
'2027 The Contact Fulcrum' (Los Angeles): cycles of contact timing from Roswell 1947 forward ~80 years; 2027 named 'a major turning point'.
'The Shifting Window of Contact' (Los Angeles): 2020's social and political changes 'will affect the window of timing for open contact'.
'Navigating the Splitting Prism' (San Francisco): overlapping parallel Earths; new permission slip for holding a preferred state of being.
Anka's book The Masters of Limitation: An ET's Observations on Earth published (Virtualbookworm).
'The Eye of the Needle: 2020 – A Pivotal Point in Human History' addresses COVID-19 origins, vaccines and the 'splitting prism'.
Anka's sci-fi comedy Alienated (writer/director/co-producer/editor) completed.
Oh No, Ross and Carrie! ep. 331 'Ross and Carrie Consult Bashar' — skeptics attend the Conscious Life Expo Q&A and test Bashar's COVID-era claims.
At Conscious Life Expo (tickets $45/$55), Bashar says '2023 is the beginning of the window of open contact through 2033'.
Ross and Carrie 'Transmit Bashar' Part 1 (ep. 377) released; Part 2 (ep. 378) follows July 9, 2023.
Bashar launches the multi-step 'Interstellar Alliance Social Experiment' (Step One, Step Two… released through 2024–25).
Anka's The Compass: A Guide for Navigating Your Life's Path published (BookBaby).
Next Level Soul interview: Bashar's 'UFO event' expected end-2026/early-2027; 2020–2050 described as a 30-year reset.
Anka's The Formula: The Instruction Manual for Living Your Best Life published (BookBaby).
'No More Secrets' Bashar event on 'consequential secrets' coming to light.
Anka is a featured speaker at Gaia's Emersion 2025 (Boulder, CO, March 15–16), presenting 'Humanity's Evolutionary Path'.
Bashar at the San Diego Transcendence Retreat (Sept 27–28, 2025).
Podcast 'Just Tap In' #248 frames Bashar's 2025–2027 'Three-Year Collapse' preceding open contact in 2027.
Bashar headlines Conscious Life Expo 2026 (Los Angeles); session keywords '2027, ET contact, heart bubbles, collective, free will'.
Mayim Bialik's Breakdown episode: Anka (41 years channeling) relays Bashar's claims that 2026 is 'the true Year of Disclosure' and 2027 brings 'face-to-face contact'.
International Business Times UK covers the podcast appearance, noting Bashar 'remains a polarizing figure' with 'no scientific evidence' for his existence.
Private sessions (60-min Zoom) listed as not yet booking for 2026; BasharTV monthly plans at $39.99 / $35 / $4.99.
